prompt:
Plan an internal audit: Scope: ISO 9001 clause 10.2 (Nonconformity and corrective action) across all departments at a multi-product manufacturing site. The site closed 89 CAPAs last year but 22% were reopened due to recurrence. Average CAPA age is 95 days (target: 60). Three major NCs from last external audit related to root cause analysis quality.

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- scope (string): scope of the change or audit
- criteria (string): audit criteria and standards
- schedule (string): audit schedule and timeline

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response:
ANSWER: {"scope":"Internal audit of ISO 9001:2015 clause 10.2 (Nonconformity and corrective action) covering all departments at the multi-product manufacturing site, focusing on CAPA effectiveness, recurrence, aging, and root cause analysis quality.","criteria":"ISO 9001:2015 clause 10.2; internal CAPA procedure (e.g., CAP-001); root cause analysis methodology (5 Whys, Fishbone, etc.); performance indicators (CAPA closure rate, recurrence rate, average CAPA age); previous external audit nonconformities related to RCA quality.","schedule":"Week 1-2: Audit planning - define scope, develop audit checklist, assign audit team.
Week 3: Issue audit notification to all departments.
Week 4-5: Conduct fieldwork - interviews, review CAPA records, evaluate root cause analyses, sample CAPA files across all departments.
Week 6: Draft audit report - present findings, discuss corrective actions.
Week 7-8: Follow-up - verify corrective action plans, close audit.
Total duration: approx. 8 weeks."}
